mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strong labor market and robust consumer spending, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with housing starts above 1,300 thousand units and retail sales above $500,000 million, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches a peak and corporate earnings growth slows, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand persons signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 thousand persons.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 3-month moving average, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth demand regime with quarterly GDP above $18,600 billion, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as robust economic expansion supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 18600.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with a strong labor market, which together lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy faces a potential slowdown.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS increase and UNRATE decline fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
